question: Do the frozen sparse-stream v3/v4 gains transfer to actual streaming SPY return prediction against Adam?
algorithm_policy: Unmodified frozen models and hyperparameters. No suffix-based selection of models, learning rates, feature transforms, reset schedules, or score windows.

data.source: stock_stream.read_bars and stock_stream.build_stream with default Args(seed=1, steps=0)
data.horizon: Every available observation; expected 468021 for unchanged source file, unless default autocull stops a view.
data.input: 224 trailing-scaled features, seven channels by 32 lags; unchanged original preprocessing and clipping.
data.target: Original clipped trailing-centred, trailing-volatility-scaled return, not raw P&L.
data.alignment: For row t, final feature bar is t+31, target return is t+33, target centring/scale use through t+32. Forecast after t+32, before t+33. No feature repair in this transfer experiment.
data.control: Independent per-observation Rademacher signs, rng seed1, multiply real targets without changing feature order or target magnitude. Each view starts from independent fresh learner states.

comparators.linear_adam: Same bias-free linear prediction class and zero initialization as sparse models, existing LinearLearner update.
comparators.mlp_adam: Existing stock MeasuredLearner and frozen bayes initialization, hidden64, seed1. Distinct nonlinear model class, included to retain original benchmark reference.
comparators.zero: Always predict zero; relative MSE equals1.
comparators.selection: Each Adam class selects its own LR on the real chronological first-quarter prefix excluding first2000 cold-start observations. Save lock exactly at boundary before suffix. Transfer these locks unchanged to random-sign control. No model reset at prefix.

metrics.primary_window: Chronological suffix after first-quarter prefix, predicting each observation before learning its label.
metrics.primary_score: Sum squared noisy prediction errors / sum squared targets. No observable clean market target.
metrics.paired_comparison: Identical consumed labels and window for each model and both prefix-locked Adam controls. Also report zero benchmark, prediction energy, signed target-prediction cross term, and temporal block loss differences.
metrics.reporting: Report all four named models; never relabel a winning secondary as the primary. Report full/partial horizon and actual suffix count explicitly. Pruned empty phases are not evidence.

interpretation.adam_win: Lower paired observed-suffix error than prefix-selected Adam, distinguishing linear and MLP comparisons.
interpretation.useful_prediction: Must also beat zero prediction on actual labels, not merely suppress Adam noise. Check magnitude, time-block consistency, and randomized-sign control before claiming market signal.
interpretation.uncertainty: One market, seed1, one historical path; sequential model selection and adaptive pruning prevent an unqualified statistical significance or investment profitability claim. Proxy advantage is not proof of optimizer superiority in neural training.

resources.experiment_time_limit: 15m per view, includes preprocessing and compilation
resources.autocull: Enabled. Four posterior candidates only; default median/EMA/warmup/patience. Observation begins on suffix with phase_start=prefix, preserving causal prefix selection and a meaningful untouched suffix. Real error-ratio progress; null also prediction-energy progress. All candidates stale before group stops. Exit75, save consumed forecasts, targets, states and phase summaries before unwind.
resources.null_dependency: After real reaches terminal state; use saved validated real locks even if real was pruned. No null training if real never reached the lock.
